{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-ufqg50",
      "toKey": "n-kv06wr",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The work was paused (event n-ufqg50) because the air-low indication occurred while boundary preparation was ongoing. The blank temporary instruction attachment field (condition n-kv06wr) indicates that no approved ECP revision or temporary instruction existed at issue time to document any service-routing change, creating a hazard scenario where an unrecorded routing change could have affected supply without proper barrier verification.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1", "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"],
      "claimIds": ["finding-1jzx7az", "claim-gyysd1"],
      "counterfactual": "If the temporary instruction attachment field had been filled with an approved document at issue time, it would have provided evidence of a documented service-routing change or confirmed that no such change occurred.",
      "competingExplanation": "The blank field may simply reflect administrative delay rather than absence of documentation; however, Section 3.6 of IA-D03 states draft preparation alone does not satisfy distribution requirements, so the lack of an approved document at issue time is a valid gap regardless of intent.",
      "evidenceGap": "Whether any unrecorded service-routing change actually occurred and whether it was authorized by engineering disposition (per Section 3.2) remains unknown."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-18ljag6",
      "toKey": "n-psg5d8",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The localized pressure drop at P-R (RHOB) while upstream P-U remained normal suggests a downstream issue within the RHOB distribution path or between North gallery and RHOB. The blank field execution record (n-psg5d8) does not establish whether this was due to an unrecorded valve change, equipment failure, or other cause.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the field execution record (WO-527-E) had been completed at issue time, it might have documented any valve changes or equipment states that could explain the localized pressure drop.",
      "competingExplanation": "The blank field may not be causally linked to the pressure loss; the interruption could stem from an unrelated upstream event affecting only RHOB distribution. However, Section 3.6 of IA-D03 requires documented ECP revision or temporary instruction for service-routing changes, so absence of documentation is a procedural gap.",
      "evidenceGap": "The specific equipment condition (valve position, equipment failure) causing the pressure drop at P-R and whether it was related to an unrecorded routing change."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-17qciec",
      "toKey": "n-rww7lb",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The shift log records 'boundary preparation in progress' but does not identify the point of interruption or valve states. The area directory (IA-D01) explicitly states it is a location index and does not establish valve positions or pressure availability at any given time, limiting ability to determine whether an unrecorded routing change occurred.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1", "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
      "claimIds": ["finding-12vbkna", "claim-ivbspk"],
      "counterfactual": "If the area directory had included valve-by-valve content or current pressure availability, it could have established whether an unrecorded routing change occurred.",
      "competingExplanation": "The lack of detailed information in these records may be due to administrative limitations rather than absence of a documented change; however, Section 3.6 of IA-D03 requires explicit documentation for service-routing changes, so the gap remains valid regardless of intent.",
      "evidenceGap": "Whether any unrecorded routing change occurred and whether it was authorized by engineering disposition."
    }
  ],
  "decision": {
    "summary": "The investigation identifies three supported causal links: (1) work pause due to air-low indication while boundary preparation was ongoing, linked to a blank temporary instruction attachment field indicating lack of documented service-routing change; (2) localized pressure drop at P-R suggesting downstream issue within RHOB distribution path, with unknown cause potentially related to unrecorded routing change or equipment failure; and (3) shift log entry noting 'boundary preparation in progress' without valve state details, linked to area directory limitations. Key gaps remain: whether an unrecorded service-routing change occurred, its authorization status, and the specific equipment condition causing pressure loss.",
    "evidenceUsed": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1", "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1", "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1", "fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"],
    "unknowns": ["Whether an unrecorded service-routing change occurred and was authorized by engineering disposition.", "The specific equipment condition causing pressure drop at P-R."],
    "alternatives": ["Pressure loss due to unrelated upstream event affecting only RHOB distribution; blank field reflects administrative delay rather than absence of documentation."],
    "confidence": 0.75
  },
  "evidenceRequests": [
    "Request claim ID 'claim-1abjb6' or structured-incident for details on unrecorded service-routing change authorization status.",
    "Request point register IA-P02 to determine if P-R reading was recorded at 09:45 AM and whether it shows normal pressure band before interruption."
  ]
}
